plugins.name: REA · Reverse Engineering

plugins.name: Android Development
plugins.description: Skill for building Android apps on the phone (Kotlin / Compose, Flutter, React Native): set up the tools, create projects, build and install APKs.

plugins.name: Browser Automation
plugins.description: Skill for doing tasks in Pico Dev's built-in browser with the Browser Automation MCP: lock the tab, find elements by ref, click, type, fill forms, search, read pages, and handle dialogs and errors.

plugins.name: ClipPolish
plugins.description: Skill for the ClipPolish MCP server: polish screen recordings (zooms, captions, blur, styles, export) and make studio videos from scenes, pictures, text and animation timed to a transcript; animate and composite like a VFX app (masks, mattes, adjustment layers, colour looks, corner pin, speed ramps, components, easy recipes); bring in files (shared folder, upload key, links) and give live preview links; write and install ClipPolish plugins.

plugins.name: 2D Video Editing Studio
plugins.description: Senior Video Editor & Autonomous 2D Production Engine (v3.5.5): 6 Official Styles (Vox/Box Paper, Stickman, Sticker, Noir, Hand-Drawn Doodle, Retro Arcade), Recipe-Driven Autopilot Edits, Voice-Synced Asset Placement, curated zero-duplicate SFX library + CATALOG.tsv, built-in DeepX Google Flow asset engine (login check → one Agent/Standard question → autopilot; Agent Mode ≤24 prompts per part back-to-back; automatic Agent fallback on unusual-activity blocks), Anti-Offline Server Shield, high-speed render presets and 15-minute timeline scaling.

plugins.name: Facebook Automation & SEO Studio
plugins.description: Pre-Trained Phone (Desktop-on-Phone www.facebook.com & Mobile Touch m.facebook.com) and Desktop Facebook Automation Engine (v1.8.4): Dedicated Feed Posts (Text/Photo/Carousel/Video), Anti-Comment Firewall (strictly never posts into comments), Reels (/reels/create + automatic mobile fallback + video event dispatch), Stories (/stories/create Photo/Video with overlay story_text & Text Story), Real Video/Reel Thumbnail & Cover Uploader, Multiline Formatted Caption Engine (Title + Description + Bullets + CTA + 3-6 #Hashtags), and Zero-Overthinking 1-Call Dispatch, and built-in DeepX Google Flow engine for AI thumbnails, Reel covers and post designs (login check → Agent/Standard question → autopilot, automatic Agent fallback on unusual-activity blocks).

plugins.name: Meta Suite Page Management
plugins.description: Master Autonomous Meta Suite Production Engine (v2.9.4): Facebook Page management that posts through Meta Business Suite (business.facebook.com composer, native scheduling, Reels thumbnails, screen locked while working, asks timing / thumbnail / caption approval first, batch projects run to completion), 1-click publishing & scheduling of Page Reels, Videos, Photos, Stories with custom thumbnails/covers, scheduled-queue manager, viral SEO + Meta algorithm audit, live trend radar (Google/YouTube, Reddit, X), anti-ad organic shield, and built-in DeepX Google Flow media engine (login check → Agent/Standard question → autopilot, automatic Agent fallback on unusual-activity blocks).

plugins.name: DeepX Google Flow Studio (DeepX MCP)
plugins.description: DeepX Google Flow Studio & DeepX MCP (v1.2.4): the complete DeepX Flow extension as an Pico Dev MCP plugin — no side panel. Instant 11ms fast-path execution, full Google Flow Agent panel recognition, checks Google login, asks Agent Mode vs Standard mode before every generation; Agent Mode auto-splits big batches into ≤24-item parts pasted back-to-back with 100% autopilot approvals; Standard mode runs on Pico Dev's native Flow engine and auto-switches to Agent Mode when Google shows an unusual-activity / extension block. Includes storyboard analyzer, characters, references, scene chaining, upscale, downloads and all deepx_* / flow_* tools. Google Flow Nov 2026 update — Agent spark switch in the prompt box, quick answers with auto side panel, and semantic project asset search (exact + similar results).

plugins.name: 3D Video Editing Studio (Stick Story)
plugins.description: Historical Stick Story / stickman video production engine restored from the earlier upstream tree: autonomous 9:16 code-driven shorts with Kokoro neural TTS, Whisper word-synced captions, acting stick figures, day/night rooms, gold step cards, procedural sound and --fast/--turbo/--1080p render presets. Full source is in the release ZIP; zero API keys.

plugins.name: Bang Motion (Pico Dev)
plugins.description: Browser motion graphics that move like real video instead of slides: openers, promos, bumpers, idents, kinetic typography, lower thirds and five explainer styles, built as one autoplaying HTML file. Includes starter scenes, references, gallery and helper scripts; ported by HassanDevo / Pico Dev.
